summary: Backend-only validation of the auto-apply behavior of POST /api/prazo/customers/{id}/add-credit. Wrote 11 pytest cases covering FIFO debt settlement, excess-to-credit, no-debt full credit, invalid amounts, 404 path, prazo_partial_payments collection contents, debts endpoint reduction, customer credit reflection, post-clearance behavior, and case-insensitive name matching. All 11 tests passed (100%). TEST_ prefixed data fully cleaned up.

minor.issue: Endpoint described in review request does not exist - only the list endpoint /api/prazo/customers is available. Tests use the list endpoint and filter by id. Not a blocker but worth adding a single-customer GET for cleaner frontend access.

Endpoint has NO auth dependency (no Depends(verify_gestor)), unlike POST /api/prazo/customers which requires gestor auth. Inconsistent and a potential security gap - any caller can mutate customer credit balances and mark prazo orders as paid without credentials.

No prazo_history audit log entry is written for the auto-apply event (the helper _log_prazo_event lives in routers/prazo.py and is not invoked in server.py). The duplicate endpoint in routers/prazo.py does log; this divergence makes audit incomplete since server.py is the one actually serving requests.

action_items: Consider adding @Depends(verify_gestor) to the add-credit endpoint at server.py:3553 for consistency with create/delete prazo customer endpoints.
Consider invoking _log_prazo_event (or an equivalent inline insert into db.prazo_history) inside the server.py add-credit endpoint so the auto-apply event is auditable.
Remove the duplicate add_prazo_credit definition in routers/prazo.py:233 (or wire only one of them through the router) to avoid future drift between the two implementations.
(Optional) Add GET /api/prazo/customers/{id} for cleaner frontend lookups.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate endpoint definitions for add_prazo_credit in server.py (line 3553) and routers/prazo.py (line 233) — risk of behavioural drift. server.py wins routing today; the version in routers/prazo.py is dead code.

server.py is 6205 lines — significantly above the 700-line guideline. Several large feature areas (kitchen, prazo, gestor analytics) should be moved to focused routers; the prazo router file already exists and could absorb these endpoints.

add-credit endpoint lacks authentication while sibling write endpoints (POST/DELETE /api/prazo/customers, /api/prazo/pay/{order_id}) require it. Recommend gating the endpoint with verify_gestor or the PRAZO_PASSWORD pattern used by pay endpoints.

The FIFO sort is `created_at` ascending using ISO-8601 string comparison on the field as stored. This works because the codebase consistently writes UTC ISO timestamps, but if any historical order lacks created_at the comparison is undefined — consider a fallback (e.g. by _id) or schema validation.
seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed with TEST_PRAZO_CRED_ and inserted/deleted within each test via autouse fixture. Mongo verified empty of prefix after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_prazo_add_credit_autoapply_jan2026.py covers T1-T10 plus a duplicate-invalid-amount case. It uses direct MongoDB inserts for unpaid prazo orders since there's no convenient public endpoint to create them, and uses the gestor-authed /api/prazo/customers POST for customer setup. The add-credit endpoint itself currently has no auth requirement.
